scope: Visible App Tab Bar fixture in the source-built x64 catalog using the Orchard DLL included in the v9 local package
method: Computer Use @oai/sky foreground pointer and keyboard input, visible focus outline and catalog selection text
limitations: The source-built catalog was exercised; independent NuGet consumer foreground input was not.
System theme was dark during the longer matrix; explicit Light and Dark received focused pointer and keyboard checks.
The automation tree reported the search box as focused after key navigation, so focus was assessed from the visible native focus outline and was not claimed as a UIA focused-element assertion.
RTL, full physical input states, actual system text scaling, complete visual/customization acceptance and native ARM64 runtime remain open.
